cards.ex: Don't forget to drop me a line when you get settled in London.
cards.exUz: Londonda joylashib olganingdan keyin menga xat yozib yuborishni unutma.
cards.uzDef: Menga tez-tez xat yozib turishni so'rash.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss the project further.
cards.exUz: Loyihani keyinroq muhokama qilish uchun keyingi hafta aloqada bo'laylik.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa muddatda aloqa o'rnatish va yangiliklarni aytish.

cards.ex: I'll get back to you with an answer by tomorrow afternoon.
cards.exUz: Ertaga tushgacha sizga javob qaytaraman.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada javob berishni va'da qilish.

cards.ex: I'm really looking forward to hearing from you soon.
cards.exUz: Sizdan tez orada xabar eshitishni juda intizorlik bilan kutaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sodir bo'lishini katta qiziqish bilan kutish.

cards.ex: Keep me posted on your progress with the application.
cards.exUz: Ariza bilan bog'liq taraqqiyotingiz haqida meni xabardor qilib turing.
cards.uzDef: Menga yangiliklar haqida xabar berib turishni so'rash.

cards.ex: I've attached my resume for your consideration.
cards.exUz: Men rezyumeni ko'rib chiqishingiz uchun ilova qildim.
cards.uzDef: Birovning e'tiboriga biror narsani taqdim etish.

cards.ex: As per our conversation, I'm sending you the documents.
cards.exUz: Suhbatimizga asosan, men sizga hujjatlarni yuboryapman.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi suhbatga asoslanib xabar berish.

cards.ex: Further to my email, I wanted to clarify a few points.
cards.exUz: Xatimga qo'shimcha ravishda, men bir nechta fikrlarni aniqlashtirmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi xatga qo'shimcha ma'lumot berish.

cards.ex: Don't hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.
cards.exUz: Agar sizda savollar bo'lsa, men bilan bog'lanishdan ikkilanmang.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa qilishdan qo'rqmaslikni yoki tortinmaslikni aytish.

cards.ex: Please reply to this email at your earliest convenience.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, ushbu xatga eng qulay vaqtingizda javob bering.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada biron narsa qilishni so'rash.

cards.ex: Give me a shout if you need any help with the project.
cards.exUz: Agar loyiha bilan bog'liq yordam kerak bo'lsa, menga xabar bering.
cards.uzDef: Menga xabar bering yoki qo'ng'iroq qiling.

cards.ex: Just a heads up, the meeting has been rescheduled for Friday.
cards.exUz: Ogohlantirmoqchiman, uchrashuv juma kuniga ko'chirildi.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan qisqacha ogohlantirish berish.

cards.ex: Let me know if you can attend the conference next month.
cards.exUz: Agar keyingi oyda konferensiyada ishtirok eta olsangiz, menga xabar bering.
cards.uzDef: Menga ma'lumot berishingizni so'rash.

cards.ex: Thank you in advance for your help with this matter.
cards.exUz: Ushbu masalada yordamingiz uchun oldindan rahmat.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa uchun oldindan minnatdorchilik bildirish.

cards.ex: Please get in touch if you have any further questions.
cards.exUz: Agar sizda qo'shimcha savollar bo'lsa, iltimos, aloqaga chiqing.
cards.uzDef: Muloqot qilish, bog'lanish.

cards.ex: Best regards, John Smith.
cards.exUz: Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Jon Smit.
cards.uzDef: Xat oxirida hurmat bilan xayrlashuv.

cards.ex: Yours sincerely, Mary Johnson.
cards.exUz: Hurmat bilan, Meri Jonson.
cards.uzDef: Xat oxirida hurmat bilan xayrlashuv (ismi ma'lum bo'lsa).

cards.ex: Yours faithfully, Customer Service Team.
cards.exUz: Sadoqat bilan, Mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish jamoasi.
cards.uzDef: Xat oxirida hurmat bilan xayrlashuv (ismi noma'lum bo'lsa).

cards.ex: To whom it may concern: I am writing to apply for...
cards.exUz: Kimga tegishli bo'lsa: Men ...ga ariza topshirish uchun yozayapman.
cards.uzDef: Xatni kimga yuborish aniq bo'lmaganda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: For any queries, please contact the support team.
cards.exUz: Savollar uchun, iltimos, qo'llab-quvvatlash jamoasiga murojaat qiling.
cards.uzDef: Savollar bilan murojaat qilish uchun yo'nalish berish.

cards.ex: It was great seeing you! Let's keep in touch.
cards.exUz: Sizni ko'rganimdan juda xursandman! Aloqada bo'laylik.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda aloqada bo'lishni taklif qilish.

cards.ex: Bear with me while I find the correct file.
cards.exUz: To'g'ri faylni topgunimcha, sabr qiling.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtinchalik qiyinchilikka sabr qilishni so'rash.

cards.ex: We need to get back on track with this project as soon as possible.
cards.exUz: Biz bu loyihani imkon qadar tezroq yo'lga tushirib olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni nazoratga qaytarish.

cards.ex: Just checking in to see how you're doing with the report.
cards.exUz: Sizning hisobot bilan qanday ishlayotganingizni bilish uchun xabar olmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa xabar bilan hol-ahvol so'rash.

cards.ex: As discussed, I'm sending you the contract to sign.
cards.exUz: Muhokama qilingandek, men sizga shartnomani imzolash uchun yuboryapman.
cards.uzDef: Oldin muhokama qilingan narsaga ishora qilish.

cards.ex: Kind regards, David Lee.
cards.exUz: Samimiy tilaklar bilan, Devid Li.
cards.uzDef: Xatning oxirida samimiy xayrlashuv.

cards.ex: To clarify, the deadline is next Friday.
cards.exUz: Aniqlashtirish uchun, oxirgi muddat kelasi juma kuni.
cards.uzDef: Tushunmovchilikni oldini olish uchun aniqlik kiritish.

cards.ex: In response to your query, I'm sending you the information.
cards.exUz: Sizning so'rovingizga javoban, men sizga ma'lumotni yuboryapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga javob berayotganingizni bildirish.

cards.ex: For further details, please visit our website.
cards.exUz: Batafsil ma'lumot uchun, iltimos, veb-saytimizga tashrif buyuring.
cards.uzDef: Qo'shimcha ma'lumot olish uchun manzil ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: On behalf of the company, I'd like to thank you.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya nomidan sizga minnatdorchilik bildirmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamning nomidan gapirish.
